title: Shakespeare Digital New Variorum: Corpus, Alignment Pipeline, and Analysis Platform
description: Archival release of the Shakespeare Digital New Variorum (Full Fathom Five) platform: OCR-derived JSON corpus of pre-1956 New Variorum Shakespeare dramatic editions, Folger alignment scripts, bibliographic resolution agents, Netlify serverless analysis functions, and retrieval-based lexical grounding (Onions 1911/1919, Schmidt 1902, Geneva Bible 1599). Live deployment: https://newvariorum.com
